These object keys are the complete DOM IDs, including the summary- prefix. IDs are #summary-samples, #summary-duration, #summary-travel, #summary-peak, #summary-gaps, #summary-speeds. No transform attribute or CSS transform on the SVG or polyline. Use all original source.rows in order: t=Number(row.time_s), d=Number(row.displacement_m). t0=first t; tn=last t; lo=Math.min(0,...all d); hi=Math.max(0,...all d). Show exact visible labels #time-axis='Time (s)' and #distance-axis='Displacement (m)'. SVG trace and all summary values remain unchanged in all four filter states.
